title: Audit verdicts bound to the PR head; done means merged
acceptance: GATE-02: record-audit needs --measured-sha (40 hex), --applies-to and --auditor; refuses a report without that exact SHA and a matching verdict line, and an auditor equal to the task's executor; stores measured_sha, applies_to, auditor, report path and report sha256.

GATE-03: approve-merge needs --pr and --approval-text, reads gh pr view, requires a PASS whose measured_sha is an ancestor of the PR head with only non-source paths changed since (light tier: a green check), records the approval and never sets done; mark-merged --pr sets done only when gh reports MERGED and records mergeCommit and mergedAt.
GATE-04: record-audit --post-merge on a done task appends the finding with a remediation task id and leaves the status; reopen is unchanged.

GATE-05: .github/workflows/audit-gate.yml job audit-gate runs scripts/audit_gate.py against the PR head; chore branches with no games/ or scripts/ source change pass trivially; branch protection and rulesets are not touched.
GATE-06: AGENTS.md and docs/workflow/TASKS.md state the rules, including the chore/agents-datastore-merge-gate rules (e8f2f07, 24ccd2a).
Tests reproduce the TASK-0138 timeline; scripts/check.sh green on the final head; PR open as ready for review; no approve, merge or mark-done by the executor.
notes: Approved by jg in chat as rows GATE-01..GATE-06 (2026-11-05). Deep tier: independent Codex PASS on the exact head required before merge. Out of scope: games/**, existing 06 QA/** reports, TASK-0138*/TASK-0139* task files, task/TASK-0139-profile-remediation, branch protection or ruleset changes, merging, recording any audit.

executions.notes: check.sh green; 86 python tests incl. TASK-0138 timeline replay; gate dry run fails as expected without an audit; see docs/workflow/evidence/TASK-0140/gate.txt
